summary: Validated user-requested TEST batch PDF-JB-TAHAP1-2026. 12/13 pytest checks + UI probe green. Batch persistence confirmed: 459 users (test_jb_* / role=student / is_active=false / is_test_data=true), 459 registrations (status=lolos), 459 profiles (data.kota=Jakarta Barat, data.nim='' blank), and 84 campus_disbursements rows all region=Jakarta Barat / stage=1 / status=sudah_dicairkan. No stage-2 records exist for the batch. Demo accounts (supri, admin.mdj, mahasiswa.mdj) untouched; no batch profile leaked outside Jakarta Barat. GET /api/admin/disbursements/campuses?region=Jakarta%20Barat returns 84 campuses / 459 recipients (matches user-supplied summary). Temporary admin_wilayah confirmed regional scoping (all campuses regions=[Jakarta Barat], PUT stage returns 403 -> read-only). One CRITICAL data-integrity bug found: 15 campus_disbursements rows have a stored campus_key that does NOT match campus_disbursement_key(cd.campus). As a result those 15 rows fail the join against final_beneficiary_rows and the Super Admin Pencairan Dana UI shows them as 'Belum ditransfer' for 79 recipients instead of 'Sudah Dicairkan'. Secondary observation: UI summary tile 'Kampus Tahap I Cair' shows 0 even though 69 campuses join correctly with sudah_dicairkan (possibly this metric counts only campuses with uploaded proof; worth confirming).

critical.issue: 15 rows for batch PDF-JB-TAHAP1-2026 store a campus_key that no longer matches campus_disbursement_key(cd.campus). Because visible_campus_groups() computes campus_key from profile.institusi (which matches campus_disbursement_key(cd.campus) for these rows), the stored row cannot be joined and its Stage-I 'sudah_dicairkan' status is lost. Affected campuses (recipients): IAI Al-Aqidah Al-Hasyimiyyah (10), Institut Ilmu Al-Qur'an IIQ (8), IISIP (1), PNJ (1), Polimedia (1), STAIINDO (3), STIEBI (1), STAI DI Al-Hikmah (4), BINUS (2), BSI (11), UNINDRA (10), UHAMKA (6), UNUSIA 'Nadhlatul' (17), UNUSIA 'Nahdlatul' (3), UNAS (1) = 79 recipients. Example: BINUS row has campus_key=campus_9f0afa1780a547de15ca but campus_disbursement_key('Universitas Bina Nusantara (BINUS)')=campus_1df8c9eee9eec3d58490.

minor.issue: sum(campus_disbursements.recipient_count) for the batch is 334 while API-computed sum(recipient_count)=459. recipient_user_ids on the stored rows are stale/partial for many campuses. Not user-visible today but could break future stage-2 sync.

critical_code_review_comments: campus_disbursements has no schema-level invariant enforcing campus_key = campus_disbursement_key(campus). Add either (a) a MongoDB validator, (b) a startup self-heal that recomputes campus_key when it drifts, or (c) drop the stored campus_key entirely and compute on read - single source of truth.

final_beneficiary_rows() joins campus_disbursements strictly by (campus_key, region, stage). A silent mismatch produces zero-error data loss. Consider logging a warning when a batch record fails to join.

ensure_campus_disbursement() upserts by (campus_key, region, stage). If a caller passes a stale campus name (different casing/whitespace) it creates orphan documents rather than updating - suggest normalising campus and recomputing key inside the function.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: 15 of 84 campus_disbursements rows created for batch PDF-JB-TAHAP1-2026 stored an incorrect campus_key. The stored key does not match campus_disbursement_key(cd.campus) - e.g. BINUS row campus_key=campus_9f0afa1780a547de15ca vs computed campus_1df8c9eee9eec3d58490 for the exact same campus string. Because visible_campus_groups() (server.py L2326-2352) joins campus_disbursements to profile-derived beneficiary rows strictly on campus_key, these 15 rows never attach to their campus group, so list_campus_disbursements() falls back to the default 'belum_diproses' stage_one for them. REPRODUCE: (1) super_admin login, (2) GET /api/admin/disbursements/campuses?region=Jakarta%20Barat, (3) filter c.stage_one.status != 'sudah_dicairkan' -> 15 items. Or open Super Admin -> Pencairan Dana and inspect rows 2, 5, 7, etc. MITIGATION: run a one-off doc update - for each campus_disbursement doc, set campus_key = campus_disbursement_key(campus). Verify by re-running the pytest file; test_every_stage_one_is_sudah_dicairkan should pass. Also add a warning log in visible_campus_groups when a campus_disbursements row is fetched but its campus_key can't be joined.
